x-m-h2-01.title: Nemo layin da mafitar lissafin logarithm take da matsala.
x-m-h2-01.goal: Nemo ka gyara matsalar da ta taso saboda ba a duba sharadin abin da ke cikin logarithm ba yayin warware lissafin logarithm.
x-m-h2-01.material: Minho ya warware log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3, ya amsa, ‘Mafitoci su ne x=5 da x=−1, guda biyu.’ Idan ana karantawa da murya, shi ne ‘log base 2 na (x minus 1) da log base 2 na (x minus 3) idan aka tara suna daidai da 3.’
x-m-h2-01.thinking.1: Nemo sharadin da aka bari a mafitar.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin mafitar Minho da ke da matsala. (Idan layuka da dama a jere suna da matsala, za ka iya zaɓar guda ɗaya kawai.)
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da aka sauya lissafi, karanta kana duba ko ma'anar ta yi daidai da layin baya.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Saka ƙimomin da ke ƙarshen mafitar kai tsaye a cikin lissafin layin farko. Me ya faru da ƙimar da ke cikin logarithm?
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.line.5: Saboda haka mafitoci su ne x = 5 da x = −1, guda biyu ne.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.explain: Matsala ta fara a layi na 2. Lokacin da aka haɗa jimillar logarithm biyu zuwa logarithm guda, sharuɗɗan abin da ke ciki x−1>0 da x−3>0 sun ɓace daga lissafi, kuma ba a rubuta su dabam ba. Don haka a layi na 5 an karɓi tushe biyun, sai layi na 6 ya zama ƙarshe. Abin cikin logarithm dole ya zama tabbatacce, don haka ana buƙatar x>3. Idan x=−1, to x−1=−2 kuma x−3=−4, abubuwan cikin logarithm ba su da kyau, saboda haka lissafin ba a ayyana shi ba. Idan x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, saboda haka ya cika lissafin. Mafita ita ce ƙima guda x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.prompt: Faɗa wa Minho mafita daidai da dalili. Haɗa matsalar da ke faruwa idan aka saka x=−1 a cikin lissafin asali.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Karanta kana duba dalilin sauya lissafi a kowane layi.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.1: Saka x=−1 da x=5 kowannensu a cikin abubuwan logarithm na lissafin asali, ka duba ƙimomin da suke samu.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa x=−1 ba mafita ba ne ta amfani da ƙimar abin da ke cikin logarithm?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi sharadin da ake buƙata kafin a sauya lissafin?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka saka x=5 cikin lissafin asali domin duba cewa ya cika shi?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.0: Mafita guda ɗaya ita ce x=5. Idan na saka x=−1, abin da ke cikin logarithm ba tabbatacce ba ne kamar log₂(−2), saboda haka ba a ayyana shi ba. Don haka 5 kaɗai, wanda ya cika sharadin x>3, mafita ce.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.1: Yayin warware lissafi, abin da ke cikin logarithm dole ne kullum ya zama tabbatacce. x−1>0 da x−3>0, saboda haka ana buƙatar x>3, kuma x=−1 ba ya cikin wannan zangon, don haka a cire shi. Amsa ita ce x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.2: Daga sharuɗɗan abubuwan logarithm x−1>0 da x−3>0, ana samun x>3. x=−1 yana wajen zangon, saboda haka a cire shi; amsar ita ce 5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.3: Amsa ita ce 5. Idan an saka x=−1, ana samun log₂(−2), wanda ba a ayyana ba, saboda haka ba mafita ba ne.

x-m-h2-04.title: Triangle nawa za a iya ginawa daga gefuna biyu da kusurwa guda?
x-m-h2-04.goal: Gwada ikirarin “koyaushe biyu ne” da ƙimomi na musamman, sannan ka bayyana da dalilai a waɗanne yanayi bai tabbata ba.
x-m-h2-04.material: A triangle ABC, ∠A=60° kuma tsawon gefen BC shi ne a=7. Idan an bayar da tsawon gefen CA, b, za ka iya ƙayyade tsawon c na gefen AB ka gina triangle. (a, b, c su ne gefunan da ke gaban ∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) Gaeun ya ce, “Idan b ya fi 7, ana gina triangles biyu koyaushe.”
x-m-h2-04.thinking.0: Ka ƙirƙiri da kanka yanayi da suka cika sharuɗɗan
x-m-h2-04.thinking.1: Zaɓi ƙimomi da ke karyata ikirarin
x-m-h2-04.prereq.0: Ratios na trigonometry da alaƙar gefuna da kusurwoyi a triangle
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.prompt: Ka gina triangles da suka cika sharuɗɗan idan b=8. Nemo tsawo biyu daban-daban da zai yiwu na gefen AB, c.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.hint.0: Saka a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 cikin dokar cosine, ka rubuta lissafin c.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi duk mafita na wannan lissafi da za a iya amfani da su a matsayin tsawon gefe.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Dole ne tsawon gefe ya fi 0.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.fail.c2: Lissafin da aka samu ta saka a=7, b=8 cikin dokar cosine a²=b²+c²−2bc·cos60° bai tabbata ba.
x-m-h2-04.s.s1.explain: Daga 49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, saboda haka c=3 ko 5. Ƙimomin biyun suna da kyau, don haka ana iya gina triangles biyu.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk ƙimomin b da za a iya amfani da su wajen karyata furucin Gaeun (idan b ya fi 7, koyaushe ana gina triangles biyu). Ga kowane b, kafa lissafin c haka nan.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane b, sake tsara 49=b²+c²−bc a matsayin quadratic a c.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ka bincika ta amfani da discriminant ko lissafin da aka sake tsarawa yana da tushen real, sannan ka kuma duba ko ƙimar tana cikin sharadin b>7.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.a: Yana zama c²−10c+51=0, wanda ba shi da tushen real. Wannan yanayi ne da ba za a iya gina ko triangle guda ba.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.b: b=5 yana wajen sharadin “b ya fi 7,” saboda haka ba ya karyata furucin Gaeun.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.c: b=8 yanayi ne da ake gina triangles biyu, saboda haka yana goyon bayan furucin Gaeun.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.d: Yana zama c²−12c+95=0, wanda ba shi da tushen real. Ba za a iya gina ko triangle guda ba.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.e: b=7 ba ya cikin sharadin “fiye da 7.” Yanayi ne da ba shi da alaƙa da furucin Gaeun.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.r.f: Yana zama c²−9c+32=0, wanda ba shi da tushen real. Ba za a iya gina triangle ba.
x-m-h2-04.s.s2.explain: Bisa dokar cosine, 49=b²+c²−bc, wato c²−bc+(b²−49)=0. Domin a samu mafita biyu masu kyau daban-daban, discriminant 196−3b² dole ya zama mai kyau kuma b>7, saboda haka b dole ya gaza kusan 8.08. Idan b=9, 10, 12 babu tushen real, don haka ba za a iya gina triangle ba. b=5 da 7 suna wajen sharadin b>7.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.prompt: Ka amsa wa Gaeun da jimla ɗaya ko biyu. Yi bayani da misalai dangane da ƙimar b ko triangles nawa ake ginawa.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ka kwatanta sakamakon b=8 da ka samo a sama da sakamakon wasu ƙimomi na b (misali 9, 10).
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ka kafa lissafin c haka nan, sannan ka ƙirga ƙimomin c masu kyau da suka dace.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka duba adadin triangles da ake samu ga ƙimar b da ka bayar ta amfani da lissafin c?
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka ambaci yanayin da ake samun triangles biyu da kuma yanayin da ba a samun ko ɗaya?
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin ka bayyana, ko da a taƙaice, dalilin da ya sa gina triangles ke tsayawa yayin da b ke ƙaruwa?
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.model.0: Ba koyaushe ba ne. Idan b=8, c=3 da 5, saboda haka biyu ne; amma idan b=10, lissafin c ba shi da mafita, don haka ba a gina triangle.
x-m-h2-04.s.s3.model.1: A’a. Idan b ya yi girma sosai, ba a gina triangle. Idan b=9 ko 10, lissafin quadratic na c ba shi da tushen real, don haka bai yiwu ba. Ana samun biyu ne kawai idan b ya ɗan fi 7, kamar b=8.

x-m-h2-06.title: Duba mafitar da ta nemo kalmar gama-gari daga jimillar jerin
x-m-h2-06.goal: Nemo ka gyara matsalar da ke cikin mafitar da ta samo kalmar gama-gari daga jimillar Sₙ na jerin, sannan ka nemo da kanka sharadin da zai ba da damar rubuta ta a matsayin dabara guda.
x-m-h2-06.material: Wannan ita ce mafitar Seoa don nemo kalmar gama-gari idan jimillar kalmomi n na farko na jerin {aₙ}, wato Sₙ=n²+2n+1. (Karanta Sₙ a matsayin “S ƙarƙashin n”, aₙ a matsayin “a ƙarƙashin n”, Sₙ₋₁ kuma “S ƙarƙashin n rage 1”.)
x-m-h2-06.thinking.1: Bambance dabarun da suka shafi zanguna daban-daban
x-m-h2-06.prereq.0: Ma’anar jimillar Sₙ da kalmar gama-gari aₙ ta jerin
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin da ke da matsala a mafitar Seoa. (Idan layuka da dama a jere suna da matsala, za ka iya zaɓar guda ɗaya kawai.)
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ka kwatanta ko sharadin (zangon n) a farkon kowane layi iri ɗaya ne da zangon da ke cikin ƙarshe.
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo kalma ta farko a₁ kai tsaye daga ma’anar Sₙ, sannan ka kwatanta da ƙimar layi na 5.
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka ga dukkan cikakkun lambobin n, aₙ=2n+1
x-m-h2-06.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne ke da matsala. Layi na 1 ya ce n≥2, saboda haka aₙ=2n+1 dabara ce da aka samo don n≥2 kawai. Dole ne a nemo kalma ta farko daban: a₁=S₁=1+2+1=4, wanda ya bambanta da 2·1+1=3. Don haka a₁=3 a layi na 5 ma ba daidai ba ne.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.prompt: Ka rubuta kalmar gama-gari daidai, sannan ka bayyana abin da Seoa bai kula da shi ba.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ana bayyana dabara ta nemo a₁ daban da aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁. Ka tuna ma’anar kalma ta farko.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ka kwatanta ƙimar 2n+1 idan n=1 da ƙimar S₁.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Shin ka nemo a₁ daga S₁ maimakon daga aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁?
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shin ka ce dole ne a duba ko dabarar da aka samo don n≥2 tana aiki ga n=1 ma?
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Shin ka rubuta kalmar gama-gari a yanayi biyu maimakon dabara guda?
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.model.0: a₁=S₁=4, kuma ga n≥2, aₙ=2n+1. Seoa bai duba ko dabarar da aka samo don n≥2 tana aiki ga n=1 ma ba. Saka n=1 yana ba da 3, wanda ya bambanta da a₁=4.
x-m-h2-06.s.s2.model.1: Dole ne a rubuta kalmar gama-gari a sassa biyu: a₁=4, kuma aₙ=2n+1 (n≥2). S₁=4 ne, amma saka n=1 cikin 2n+1 yana ba da 3, saboda haka ba su yi daidai ba. Dole ne a nemo kalma ta farko daban.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.prompt: Ga Sₙ=p·n²+q·n+r (p, q, r lambobi cikakku ne, p≠0), nemo nau’i-nau’i uku daban-daban na (p, q, r) waɗanda ƙimar da aka samu idan an saka n=1 cikin dabarar da aka samo don n≥2 ta yi daidai da a₁, don a iya rubuta kalmar gama-gari da dabara guda.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ga Sₙ=pn²+qn+r, ka bayyana Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁ idan n≥2 ta fuskar p da q.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ka kwatanta ƙimar da aka samu idan an saka n=1 cikin wannan dabara da S₁=p+q+r.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.ok.c1: p lamba cikakkiya ce wadda ba 0 ba.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.fail.c1: p, q, r lambobi cikakku ne kuma p ba zai zama 0 ba.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.ok.c2: Ƙimar dabarar da aka samo don n≥2 a n=1 ta yi daidai da a₁=S₁.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Ƙimar p+q ta dabarar p(2n−1)+q da aka samo don n≥2 a n=1 ba ta yi daidai da S₁=p+q+r ba.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.explain: Ga n≥2, aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁=p(2n−1)+q, saboda haka saka n=1 yana ba da p+q. a₁=S₁=p+q+r, saboda haka suna daidai ne kawai idan r=0. Sₙ=n²+2n+1 yana da r=1, don haka dole ne a kula da kalma ta farko daban.

x-m-h2-07.title: Shin ∞−∞ ya yi daidai da 0? Duba ikirarin abokai biyu
x-m-h2-07.goal: Gwada ikirari biyu da lissafin lambobi, bayyana inda tunanin fahimta ya yi kuskure, sannan ka nemo limit ta amfani da algebra.
x-m-h2-07.material: Minsu ya ce, “Yayin da x ke ƙaruwa ba iyaka, √(x²+x) yana kusantar x, saboda haka √(x²+x)−x yana kusantar 0.” Seoa ya ce, “Ba ya kusantar 0, yana kusantar wani adadi mai kyau.” Yadda ake karantawa: √(x²+x) tushen x squared da x ne, “x yana ƙaruwa ba iyaka” kuma x→∞ ne.
x-m-h2-07.thinking.0: Gwada ikirarin da shaida ta lambobi
x-m-h2-07.prereq.0: Ma’anar limit yayin da x ke ƙaruwa ba iyaka
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.prompt: Za ka iya amfani da kalkuleta. Zaɓi cikakkun lambobi x guda uku waɗanda ba ƙasa da 100 ba, lissafa √(x²+x)−x, zagaye zuwa wuraren goma uku, sannan ka shigar da shi a matsayin (x, ƙima). Shigar da x daban-daban uku yana kammala shi. (Idan ikirarin Minsu daidai ne, wannan ƙima ya kamata ta kusanci 0 yayin da x ke ƙaruwa.)
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x=100 da x=1000 cikin √(x²+x)−x ka lissafa.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka ƙara girman x sosai ka lura ta wace hanya ƙimar ke motsawa.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.ok.c1: x cikakkiyar lamba ce mai aƙalla 100.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.fail.c1: x dole ta zama cikakkiyar lamba mai aƙalla 100.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.ok.c2: Ƙimar da ka shigar ta yi daidai da sakamakon lissafin √(x²+x)−x.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.fail.c2: Ƙimar da ka shigar ta bambanta da sakamakon lissafin. Sake lissafta √(x²+x)−x da na'urar lissafi, sannan ka zagaye zuwa wuraren decimal 3.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.explain: Ga x=100 kusan 0.4988 ne, ga x=1000 kusan 0.49988 ne, kuma ga x=10000 kusan 0.49999 ne. Ko da ka ƙara girman x, ƙimar ba ta kusantar 0, tana nan kusa da 0.5.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.prompt: Idan aka duba sakamakon lissafi, wace magana ce Minsu ko Seoa ta bayar da hujja mafi kyau? Zaɓi bayani mafi inganci.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sanya ƙimomin da aka lissafta ga ƙimomin x guda 3 gefe da gefe, ka ga yadda ƙimar ke sauyawa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bambanta ko "kusantowa" yana magana ne kan rabo ko bambanci.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.a: Maganar Seoa tana da goyon baya. Bambancin yana taruwa kusa da ƙima marar 0.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.a: Ko da aka ƙara x, ƙimar ba ta canza daga kusan 0.5 ba, saboda haka wannan hujja ce da ke adawa da da'awar cewa ita ce 0.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.b: Minsu tana da gaskiya. Rabo yana kusantar 1, saboda haka bambanci ma yana kusantar 0.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.b: Rabo ya kusanci 1 ba ya nufin bambanci ya kusanci 0. Misali, rabon x da x+0.5 yana kusantar 1, amma bambancin koyaushe 0.5 ne.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.c: Minsu tana da gaskiya. Ƙimar da ta fi 0 kuskuren na'urar lissafi ce.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.c: Idan ka sauya x kuma ƙimomin suka taru kusa da ƙima ɗaya (kusa da 0.5), yana da wuya a ɗauke ta a matsayin kuskure.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.d: Ba za a iya sani ta kowace hanya ba. Lissafi ba ya gaya mana komai.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.d: Lambobi ba sa tabbatar da limit, amma suna zama hujja da ke adawa da da'awar cewa ita ce "0".
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.explain: Ƙimomin da aka lissafta suna taruwa kusa da 0.5 yayin da x ke ƙaruwa, saboda haka maganar Seoa tana da goyon baya. Amma lambobi hujja ne kawai, don sanin ainihin ƙimar sai an canza tsarin lissafin.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta dalilin da ya sa tunanin Minsu, ‘√(x²+x) yana kusantar x, don haka bambancin 0 ne,’ ba daidai ba ne, sannan nemo ƙimar limit ta hanyar canza tsarin lissafin.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta abin da mai ƙidaya zai zama idan aka ninka kuma aka raba √(x²+x)−x da √(x²+x)+x.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.hint.1: Raba mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa da x, sannan ka duba ƙimar da kowane ɓangare yake kusantowa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa har abada.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bambanta tsakanin ƙimomi biyu da suke kusantowa da bambancin ƙimomi biyu da ke zuwa 0?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Canjin da ka yi ya mayar da lissafin zuwa siffar da za a iya nemo limit ɗinsa?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ƙimar da ka gani ta lissafi (0.4999…) da limit ɗin da ka samo sun yi daidai?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.model.0: Kusantar x yana nufin rabon ya kusanci 1, ba wai bambancin ya zama 0 ba. Idan aka rationalize mai ƙidaya, ana samun x/(√(x²+x)+x)=1/(√(1+1/x)+1), kuma yayin da x→∞ yana zama 1/2.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.model.1: Ko da √(x²+x) ya yi kama da x, har yanzu akwai bambanci tsakanin lambobin biyu, saboda haka kada in mayar da shi x−x=0. Idan aka ninka mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa da conjugate √(x²+x)+x, ana samun x/(√(x²+x)+x), kuma limit ɗin 0.5 (=1/2) ne.

x-m-h2-08.title: Daga saurin matsakaici zuwa saurin a wannan take.
x-m-h2-08.goal: Rage zangon lokaci, ka ga ƙimar da saurin matsakaici yake kusantowa, sannan ka tsara ma'anar saurin a wannan take da kanka.
x-m-h2-08.material: Ƙwallo tana gangarowa kan tudu, tana yin nisan s(t)=t² (a mita) cikin t daƙiƙa. Kana son sanin saurinta ‘a wannan take’ idan t=1 daƙiƙa. Amma sauri shi ne (nisan da aka yi)÷(lokacin da aka ɗauka), kuma a ‘take guda’ lokacin 0 ne, saboda haka kamar ba za a iya rabawa ba.
x-m-h2-08.thinking.2: Tsara ma'anar ƙimar canji a wannan take.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanan a sassa ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta tsawon zangon lokaci da saurin matsakaici gefe da gefe bisa bayanan da aka bayyana.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko hasashenka da sabuwar ƙima sun yi daidai; idan ba haka ba, yi tunanin abin da ka rasa.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Saurin matsakaici a zangon [1, 3] daƙiƙa shi ne (9−1)÷2 = 4 m/s.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me za ka yanke game da saurin a wannan take t=1 daƙiƙa?
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan zangon ya yi tsawo, sauri yana canzawa a cikinsa, saboda haka saurin matsakaici ya bambanta da saurin a take guda. Mu rage zangon.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Saurin 4 m/s ne. Saurin matsakaici shi ne saurin a wannan take.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Idan sauri yana canzawa cikin zangon, ba za ka ce saurin matsakaici daidai yake da saurin a farkon take ba.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ba zan iya cewa tukuna ba. Ina buƙatar nemo saurin matsakaici a gajerun zanguna da suka fara a daƙiƙa 1 ma.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Maimakon yanke hukunci kan take guda ta amfani da matsakaicin zangon da ya yi tsawo, kana gwadawa ta amfani da gajerun zanguna.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba zan iya sani ba. A take guda lokacin 0 ne, don haka ba za a iya bayyana sauri ba.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ba za ka iya raba kai tsaye a zangon lokaci 0 ba, amma akwai hanyar kusantar ƙimar ta amfani da gajerun zanguna.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Saurin matsakaici a zangon [1, 2] shi ne 3; a [1, 1.5] shi ne (2.25−1)÷0.5 = 2.5; a [1, 1.1] kuma shi ne (1.21−1)÷0.1 = 2.1 m/s.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idan ka ƙara rage zangon, kamar [1, 1.01], [1, 1.001], me zai faru da saurin matsakaici?
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.after: [1, 1.01] yana ba da (1.0201−1)÷0.01 = 2.01, kuma [1, 1.001] yana ba da 2.001. Mai ƙidaya da mai ƙididdigewa duka suna kusantar 0, amma rabo yana taruwa kusa da 2.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yana kusantar 0. Domin tsawon zangon yana kusantar 0.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka duba tsawon zangon kawai. Nisan da aka yi ma yana ƙanƙanta tare da shi, saboda haka dole ka duba rabon.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ba ya canzawa daga kusa da 2.1.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yayin da aka rage [1, 1.5] zuwa [1, 1.1], ya ci gaba da sauka daga 2.5 zuwa 2.1.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka yi hasashen ƙimar da yake taruwa kusa da ita daga yadda saurin matsakaici ke raguwa: 3, 2.5, 2.1.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Gaba ɗaya, saurin matsakaici a zangon [1, 1+h] shi ne ((1+h)²−1)÷h = 2+h (h≠0).
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yayin da h ke kusantar 0 har abada ba tare da zama 0 ba, ta yaya ya dace a bayyana saurin a take idan t=1 daƙiƙa?
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Saurin a take shi ne ƙimar 2 da saurin matsakaici 2+h ke kusantowa yayin da h→0. Ana kiran wannan ƙima derivative a t=1.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: h shi ne tsawon zangon, kuma saurin a take ita ce ƙima guda da ake kusantowa yayin da zangon ke raguwa.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ba za a iya ƙayyade shi ba. Saka h=0 yana ba da 0÷0.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Asalin lissafin ((1+h)²−1)÷h ba a ayyana shi idan h=0, amma za ka iya duba ƙimar da sauƙaƙa 2+h yake kusantowa.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 2 ne. Ita ce ƙimar da saurin matsakaici 2+h ke kusantowa yayin da h ke kusantar 0 har abada.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Maimakon saka h=0, ka ɗauki wurin da ƙimar ke kusantowa yayin da h ke kusantar 0 a matsayin saurin a take.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ka ɗauki saurin matsakaici 4 a dogon zango a matsayin saurin a take, amma bayan ganin a bayanan cewa ƙimar ta taru kusa da 2 yayin da zangon ke raguwa, ka sake duba hukuncinka. Ƙimar canji a take ba 0÷0 ba ce; ita ce ƙimar da matsakaicin ƙimar canji ke kusantowa.
x-m-h2-08.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta yadda ka sauya hukuncin da ya ɗauki saurin matsakaici 4 a zangon [1, 3] a matsayin saurin a t=1 daƙiƙa.

x-m-h2-08.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta yadda tsawon zangon da ka lissafta saurin matsakaici a cikinsa ya sauya.
x-m-h2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka kwatanta hukuncin farko (4) da hukuncin baya (2)?
x-m-h2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka yi amfani da ƙimomin saurin matsakaici (2.5, 2.1, da sauransu) a matsayin hujja?
x-m-h2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka faɗi dalilin da ya sa dogon zango ya sa ya bambanta da saurin a take?
x-m-h2-08.s.s2.model.0: Da farko na ɗauki saurin matsakaici 4 a [1,3] a matsayin saurin a wannan take, amma idan zangon ya yi tsawo sauri yana canzawa a tsakiyarsa, saboda haka bai dace ba. Da na rage zangon zuwa 1.5 da 1.1, saurin matsakaici 2.5 da 2.1 sun kusanci 2, don haka na sauya tunani na ce saurin a take 2 ne.
x-m-h2-08.s.s2.model.1: Yayin da zangon ke raguwa, saurin matsakaici yana ƙara kusantar take guda. 2.1, 2.01, 2.001 suna kusantar 2 har abada, saboda haka na ɗauki sauri a t=1 a matsayin 2. Dalilin da na fara tunanin 4 shi ne zangon ya yi tsawo sosai.

x-m-h2-09.thinking.1: Yanke shawara ko sharadin ya wadatar.
x-m-h2-09.prereq.0: Ma'anar derivative da nemo derivatives na ayyukan polynomial.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.prompt: Nemo nau'i uku dabam na cikakkun lambobi a,b inda f ke da c mai f'(c)=0 amma babu extremum (ba ya raguwa a kowane zango), domin ƙirƙirar misalan ƙarya.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ka hango jadawalin f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b (parabola da ke buɗewa sama). Domin f ya sami extremum, alamar f' dole ta canza.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin yadda wannan parabola dole ta taɓa axis x domin f'(c)=0 amma alamar f' ba ta canza ba.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.ok.c2: f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b tana taɓa axis x. Akwai c mai f'(c)=0, amma alamar f' ba ta canza.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.fail.c2: Discriminant 4a²−12b na f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b ba 0 ba ne. Idan ya fi 0, alamar f' tana canzawa kuma extremum yana bayyana; idan ya kasa 0, babu c mai f'(c)=0.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.explain: Idan f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b ta taɓa axis x (discriminant 4a²−12b=0, wato a²=3b), to f'(x)=3(x+a/3)²≥0, saboda haka duk da akwai wuri inda f'=0, f yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa. Misali, idan a=0, b=0, to f(x)=x³ kuma f'(0)=0 amma babu extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.prompt: A cikin ayyukan da ka ƙirƙira a sama, f'(c)=0 amma babu extremum. Wane sharadi ne ya fi dacewa domin samun extremum?
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Duba alamar f'(x) ga aikin da ka ƙirƙira a matakin baya, a hagu da dama na c.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ma'anar extremum (sauyawa daga ƙaruwa zuwa raguwa da sauransu) da kowane zaɓi.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.a: f'(c)=0 kuma alamar f' tana canzawa a ɓangarorin biyu na c.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.a: Ka nuna cewa baya ga f'(c)=0, ana kuma buƙatar sharadin sauyawa tsakanin ƙaruwa da raguwa.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.b: Idan f'(c)=0 ne kawai, kullum extremum ne ko da wace alama ce.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.b: A misalin da ka yi a baya (f(x)=x³ da sauransu), f'(0)=0 amma babu extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.c: f'(c)=0 kuma ƙimar aikin f(c) dole ta zama 0.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.c: Ƙimar f(c) ba ta da alaƙa da ko akwai extremum. Ga f(x)=x³+1, f'(0)=0 kuma f(0)=1, amma babu extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.d: Idan f'(c)>0 ne, gangaren layin tangent a wannan wuri tabbatacce ne, saboda haka aikin yana ƙaruwa. Ba ɗan takarar extremum ba ne.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.explain: Domin c ya zama extremum, f'(c)=0 kuma alamar f' dole ta canza a ɓangarorin biyu na c (ƙaruwa↔raguwa). f'(c)=0 sharadi dole ne kawai ga ɗan takarar extremum.

x-m-h2-02.title: Shin ƙarfin 2 kullum ya fi murabba'in x?
x-m-h2-02.goal: Nemo misalin ƙarya ga da'awar cewa 2ˣ>x² kullum gaskiya ne, sannan yanke shawara daga wace ƙima yake fara aiki.
x-m-h2-02.material: Seojin ya ga cewa idan x=1, 2¹=2>1², kuma idan x=5, 2⁵=32>5²=25, sai ya ce, ‘Ga cikakkiyar lamba x tabbatacciya, 2ˣ kullum ya fi x².’ (2ˣ ita ce lambar da ake samu idan an ninka 2 da kanta sau x, kuma x² ita ce lambar da ake samu idan an ninka x sau biyu.)
x-m-h2-02.thinking.1: Bambanta gwada wasu yanayi da bayyana dalilin.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.prompt: Nemo cikakkun lambobi tabbatattu x guda 2 dabam da ke nuna maganar Seojin ba daidai ba ce. (Wato x inda 2ˣ ba ya fi x², wato 2ˣ≤x².)
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x=1, 2, 3, ... a jere, sannan rubuta ƙimomin 2ˣ da x² gefe da gefe.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ƙimomin tsakanin x=1 da x=5 da Seojin ya gwada.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.fail.c1: x dole ya zama cikakkiyar lamba mai aƙalla 1.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.fail.c2: Ga wannan x, 2ˣ ya fi x². Ba ƙima ba ce da take karya maganar Seojin.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.explain: Idan x=2, to 2²=4=2²; idan x=3, to 2³=8<9=3²; idan x=4, to 2⁴=16=4². Waɗannan ukun misalan ƙarya ne. Idan x=1 ko x=5, 2ˣ ya fi.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu kana son cewa, ‘Ga kowace cikakkiyar lamba x mai aƙalla 5, 2ˣ>x².’ Wane dalili ne ya fi dacewa da tabbatar da cewa wannan kullum gaskiya ne?
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bambanta ko kowane zaɓi yana cewa ‘dalilin da ya sa yake haka ga kowace x’ ko kuma ‘yawan yanayin da aka gwada’ kawai.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta a jadawali sau nawa kowane ƙima biyu ke ƙaruwa daga x=5 zuwa 6 da 7.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.a: Na lissafta ɗaya bayan ɗaya daga x=5 zuwa x=20, na ga 2ˣ>x² a kowane lokaci ba tare da keɓancewa ba.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.a: Ko da ka gwada yanayi 20, ba za ka san ko ƙima ta gaba tana cika sharadin ba. Gwada wasu yanayi shaida ce, ba dalili ba.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.b: Idan x ya ƙaru da 1, 2ˣ yana ninkuwa da 2, kuma x² yana ƙaruwa da ƙasa da ninki 2 (idan x≥3).
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.b: Wannan yana kwatanta yawan ƙarin kowace ƙima a kowane mataki, ya kuma gano dalilin da rata take ci gaba da faɗaɗa.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.c: 2ˣ aikin exponential ne kuma x² aikin polynomial ne, saboda haka 2ˣ ya fi daga x=5 zuwa gaba.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.c: Gaskiya ne cewa aikin exponential daga ƙarshe yana zama mafi girma, amma ba haka yake tun farko ba, kamar a x=3. Wannan bai bayyana daga wace ƙima yake fara ba.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.d: Idan ka zana jadawalan, jadawalin 2ˣ yana sama da na x².
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.d: Jadawali yana taimaka wa zato, amma inda jadawalan biyu suke kusa sosai yana da wuya a bambanta da ido, kuma bai bayyana dalilin ba.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.explain: A x=5, 2⁵=32>25, kuma idan x ya ƙaru da 1, 2ˣ yana ninkuwa da 2 yayin da x² ke ninkuwa da (x+1)²/x², wanda ya kasa 2 idan x≥3. Don haka idan ya fara gaba, tazarar tana ci gaba da ƙaruwa. Gwada wasu ƙimomi, nau'in aiki, ko siffar jadawali kaɗai ba ya bayyana ‘kowace x’.

x-m-h2-03.title: Shin sinθ=3/5 kaɗai zai iya gaya mana tanθ?
x-m-h2-03.goal: Nemo yanayin da bayanin da aka bayar bai ƙayyade ƙima guda ɗaya ba, sannan zaɓi bayanin da ake buƙata domin ƙayyade ƙimar.
x-m-h2-03.material: Jihu ya faɗi kawai cewa ‘sinθ=3/5 ga kusurwa θ’ sannan ya nemi ƙimar tanθ. Daeun ta ce, ‘Bayanin bai isa ba,’ Hyunwoo kuma ya ce, ‘Ya isa.’ Yadda ake karantawa: sinθ shi ne sine theta, cosθ shi ne cosine theta, tanθ shi ne tangent theta, kuma 3/5 shi ne uku bisa biyar.
x-m-h2-03.thinking.0: Nemo dukkan yanayin da zai yiwu.
x-m-h2-03.thinking.1: Yanke shawara ko bayanin ya isa.
x-m-h2-03.prereq.0: Ma'anar ayyukan trigonometry da muhimman alaƙoƙi.
x-m-h2-03.prereq.1: Wurin da kusurwa take bisa quadrant.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.prompt: Idan akwai kusurwa θ mai sinθ=3/5, nemo nau'i biyu dabam na ƙimomin da za su yiwu (cosθ, tanθ). (Shigar da cosθ=c da tanθ=t; za ka iya rubuta decimal. Misali 3/5=0.6.)
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Saka sinθ=0.6 cikin sin²θ+cos²θ=1, sannan rubuta yadda lissafin cosθ yake zama.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirga ƙimomin cosθ nawa ne suka cika wannan lissafi, sannan lissafta tanθ=sinθ÷cosθ ga kowanne.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.fail.c1: Ba ya sa sin²θ+cos²θ=1. Duba abin da murabba'in cosθ dole ya zama idan sinθ=0.6.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.fail.c2: tanθ bai yi daidai da sinθ÷cosθ ba.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.explain: Idan sinθ=3/5, to cos²θ=16/25, don haka cosθ=4/5 ko −4/5. Idan cosθ=0.8, tanθ=0.75; idan cosθ=−0.8, tanθ=−0.75, don haka yanayi biyu suna yiwuwa.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.prompt: Idan ƙari ga sinθ=3/5 an kuma gaya maka ɗaya daga cikin bayanai masu zuwa, ƙimar tanθ za ta zama guda ɗaya. Zaɓi duk bayanan da suka dace.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ka duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowanne daga cikin yanayi biyun da ka samo a matakin baya ya cika sharadin kowane zaɓi.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ka ware zaɓuɓɓukan da yanayi biyun ke cika sharadi daga waɗanda yanayi guda ɗaya ne kawai ya rage.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.a: Kusurwa mai kyau na iya kasancewa a kowane quadrant. Ka duba ko yanayi biyun da ka ƙirƙira a baya suna nan.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.o.b: θ kusurwa ce a quadrant na biyu
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.b: Wannan sharadi yana barin yanayi guda ɗaya kacal. Ka duba alamar cosθ a quadrant na biyu.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.o.c: θ kusurwa ce a quadrant na farko ko na biyu
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.c: Idan sinθ=3/5>0, ka riga ka san wannan, don haka ba sabon bayani ba ne. Yanayi biyun suna nan.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.d: Idan sinθ>0 kuma tanθ<0, alamar cosθ ta tabbata. Ka duba wanne daga cikin yanayi biyun na baya ya rage.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.e: Wannan zangon ya haɗa da quadrant na farko da na biyu, saboda haka yanayi biyun suna nan.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.f: Yana gaya maka alamar cosθ kai tsaye, saboda haka yanayi guda ɗaya ne kawai ya rage.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.explain: Idan sinθ=3/5, to cosθ=±4/5, saboda haka idan ka san alamar cosθ, tanθ ta tabbata. Quadrant na biyu, tanθ<0 (cosθ<0 domin sinθ>0), da cosθ<0 duk suna nufin cosθ<0, saboda haka tanθ=−3/4 ta tabbata. Ga sauran, yanayin cosθ>0 yana nan, don haka akwai ƙimomi biyu na tanθ.
